summary: Black Rock Petroleum Company filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that President/CEO and Treasurer Zoltan Nagy was indicted on a criminal offense in the Northern District of Atlanta Division on August 9, 2022, related to Lotus Bio-Technology Development Corp.; the company notes the allegations are unproven in court and that prior filings since August 2022 may or may not have included this disclosure. Nagy signed the delayed September 16, 2026 report. No trading market or ticker exists, no terms, advisors, board recommendation, or regulatory clock are stated. Risk angle: leadership criminal exposure and reporting-lag disclosure questions.
